ValidationRule.description: Restricts "Referred" Leads to final stages only (Converted or Closed Lost).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Referred"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Converted")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed Lost")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid status change. Once "Referred", the Lead can only be "Converted" or marked as "Closed Lost".
